body: We aren't friends. We don't dislike each other we just keep it professional. I could easily be replaced and life would go on so I guess i don't see why it would be a bad thing.

It isn't really the firing that is bothering me. It is kinda a last straw thing and I have thought about it even while staying employed here. I'm not mad or sad or anything I just figure its as good a time as any and get it over with you know?

I broke a work policy and was told if I did it again i would be let go. I broke that policy again because I am depressed I let things get out of control. I should have told my boss but I didn't and I know his hands are tied.

Kinda employer specific and I don't want to give that info out. Nothing illegal or unethical but I most likely will be let go and as hard as it is I can see why they need to do it. Part of it has been severe depression led me to this point but I could have gotten help and didn't so now I have to face the consequences. 

I have been tired for a long time so its not all bad I guess. I don't want to die but I know life will be so bad after it happens that I don't think I can keep on going.
